proposals.observable_claim: query displaced-to array and nonnegative offset as two values; a displaced view shares elements with the backing array
proposals.positive_witness_spec: make array A; make B displaced to A at offset 1; write B[0], require A[1] changed; query B -> (A,1)
proposals.falsifier_spec: B is instead an independent copy so mutation does not reach A; or returns an unrelated backing array

proposals.observable_claim: change array dimensions, preserve bounded original entries as specified, optional adjustable identity and displacement/re-aliasing; do not infer universal in-place behavior
proposals.positive_witness_spec: adjust explicitly adjustable 2x3 array to 4x6; original known positions retain elements; new shape and distinct/improper alias cases checked
proposals.falsifier_spec: reshape always destroys old contents or always returns same object even when not adjustable

proposals.observable_claim: deposit low bits of value in specified contiguous target integer bit-field, preserving all target bits outside that field
proposals.positive_witness_spec: for byte-field [position p,width w], show LDB(field, DPB(v,field,x)) equals low_w_bits(v), unchanged exterior bits of x
proposals.falsifier_spec: source bits overwrite upper/lower bits outside chosen field, or do not mask value to w bits

proposals.observable_claim: locate an existing generalized place as a first-class reference to that same cell (not allocate a detached new cell)
proposals.positive_witness_spec: obtain reference to array element, update through reference, observe same original element changes; require lifetime/alias safety model
proposals.falsifier_spec: reference points to a detached copy, or lets invalid pointer escape lifetime boundary

proposals.observable_claim: preserve all first-form return values, execute later effects in sequence, and return exactly the preserved cardinality and values
proposals.positive_witness_spec: first expression yields (a,b); later expression changes state and yields c; overall result still (a,b) and effect occurred
proposals.falsifier_spec: only primary a retained or final c replaces first values

proposals.observable_claim: map runtime object identity to positive integer, such that equal integer iff EQ identity; historically pointer or table-based, no portable persistent address guarantee
proposals.positive_witness_spec: two distinct EQ-nonidentical cons cells map to different live ids; identical object maps to same live id
proposals.falsifier_spec: structural equality alone forces same identity id; id asserted stable after serialization/restart

proposals.observable_claim: reverse a live object identity integer previously produced by MAKNUM; arbitrary/forged numbers are outside guaranteed contract
proposals.positive_witness_spec: for a live x, MUNKAM(MAKNUM(x)) is EQ to x
proposals.falsifier_spec: accept arbitrary forged handle as a valid object or claim stable cross-process object restoration

proposals.observable_claim: declaration of expected type(s) of expression result(s), preserving exact return value cardinality; mismatched types have undefined consequences, NOT mandated runtime check
proposals.positive_witness_spec: correctly typed two-result expression returns the same two values with declaration in place
proposals.falsifier_spec: wrongly claim THE necessarily throws runtime type error for a violated declaration
